scenarios.name: Controlled target boundary approach
scenarios.purpose: Requalify the Commons-seeded sensor and the complete target observation, detection, and presentation chain under the admitted target environment.
inputOrThreatProfile: One known synthetic object approaching on the frozen target path
scenarios.duration: One hour maximum per target qualification session
scenarios.coverageGeometry: Frozen target path and boundary coordinates

operatorConditions.training: Target fixture orientation and acknowledgement procedure
operatorConditions.priorKnowledge: Operator knows the target class but not the presentation timestamp
permittedIntervention: Abort for safety, fixture failure, or receipt failure

degradedConditions: One delayed-observation replay retained as diagnostic evidence
assumptions: The exact admitted candidate architecture is loaded before every scored run.

metrics.name: Target detection before boundary crossing
metrics.quantity: Whether a target detection event occurs before the frozen boundary-crossing timestamp
metrics.measurementMethod: Compare the first valid target detection-event timestamp with the target ground-truth boundary-crossing timestamp for each scored pass.
metrics.samplingMethod: Ten scored single-object passes using the frozen target path and target profile
metrics.allowedUncertainty: Target timestamp uncertainty must remain below 10 milliseconds; otherwise the run is inconclusive.
metrics.failureCondition: Any valid scored pass lacks a detection before boundary crossing.
limitations: Known synthetic target class and controlled target environment only.

metrics.name: Target observation-to-presentation latency
metrics.quantity: Elapsed time between first qualifying target observation and operator presentation
metrics.measurementMethod: Subtract the first qualifying target observation timestamp from the corresponding target presentation timestamp under the shared run clock.
metrics.samplingMethod: Measure one latency value for each of ten valid scored target passes
metrics.allowedUncertainty: Combined target timestamp uncertainty must remain below 10 milliseconds.
metrics.failureCondition: The 95th percentile target latency exceeds 2 seconds or any required event lacks a valid timestamp.
limitations: Single-object and single-operator target fixture only.

instrumentation.name: Target qualification run clock
instrumentation.accuracy: Better than 10 milliseconds across the bounded target run
instrumentation.clockSource: One target host monotonic clock distributed through the event recorder
instrumentation.dataFormat: RFC3339 wall time plus monotonic nanoseconds in JSON Lines

instrumentation.name: Target immutable event and intervention recorder
instrumentation.accuracy: Lossless for valid target fixture events
instrumentation.dataFormat: Append-only JSON Lines with per-record digest

comparators.name: Frozen target operator requirement
limitations: This comparator establishes bounded target mission adequacy only; it is not a vendor baseline.

accountingBoundary.evaluationPeriod: Acquisition, target integration, and one bounded qualification campaign
accountingBoundary.missionDenominator: One integrated target candidate and ten valid scored passes in the frozen target scenario

prohibitedActivities: Active transmission outside the isolated target fixture
authorizations.timeBoundary: During the bounded target qualification session only
authorizations.rationale: The target fixture is passive, isolated, and contains no regulated active effect.
